why: One layout, two renderers: lua/core/cli_view.lua and rust/wa-term's Editor draw the same console, and on 2026-11-11 two rendering bugs came from the twins disagreeing (the status-row geometry and session_content) rather than from either being wrong on its own. This file is the contract BOTH tests read: scripts/test-twin-render.lua asserts the Lua side and the `twin_frames_agree_with_the_shared_fixture` test in rust/wa-term/src/terminal_editor.rs asserts the Rust side, so a change to one renderer that the other does not follow fails where it was made. Add a case here when a frame's state matters; never edit an expectation to match one side alone.
